json.text: After taking a cart, agents may walk without it only during a short on-foot excursion in a single-file shelf aisle or its mouth.

all_hypotheses.description: [g1_recover_cart_after_parking] OBLIGED: after cartParkedAtMouth, eventually cartRecoveredAtMouth (before exit)  where aisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∨ at(6,3)); cartParkedAtMouth := (aisleMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart; cartRecoveredAtMouth := (aisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart

json.text: Shelf interactions inside single-file shelf aisles must be performed on foot, without holding or pushing a cart.

json.text: At shelf faces in wide aisles, agents should interact with the shelf while still having their cart.

json.text: In broad open travel aisles, agents are prohibited from moving around without their cart, except at a narrow-aisle mouth where the cart is being parked or retrieved.

json.text: Once an agent enters a single-file shelf aisle without a cart, they are obliged to return to and regain the cart before exiting.

all_hypotheses.description: [g1_retrieve_after_leaving_single_file] OBLIGED: after exitSingleFileWithoutCart, eventually takeCart (before exit)  where singleFileAisle := (shelfE ∧ shelfW ∧ freeWidthH≤1); exitSingleFileWithoutCart := (¬hasCart ∧ singleFileAisle ∧ MOVE) · ¬singleFileAisle; takeCart := (¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart

json.text: After coming back out of a single-file aisle without a cart, the shopper must retrieve the parked cart.

all_hypotheses.description: [g1_wide_front_shelf_service_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: (wideShelfFront ∧ INTERACT ∧ ¬hasCart)  where wideShelfFront := (adjShelf ∧ freeWidthH≥2)

all_hypotheses.description: [g1_parking_implies_using_no_cart_aisle] OBLIGED: after setDownCartInOpenAisle, eventually enterSingleFileWithoutCart (before exit)  where openCrossAisle := (freeWidthH≥3 ∧ freeWidthV≥3 ∧ ¬adjShelf); singleFileAisle := (shelfE ∧ shelfW ∧ freeWidthH≤1); enterSingleFileWithoutCart := (¬hasCart ∧ MOVE) · singleFileAisle; setDownCartInOpenAisle := (openCrossAisle ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart

json.text: A shopper should set the cart down in an open aisle only when they are about to enter a no-cart single-file aisle.
